title: [spec-gap][R-BB-012] Mesh backpressure NACK: docs+vectors promise NACK-upstream, runtime implements local-only recording
description: spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md:124-128: use an existing protocol failure response for mesh-forwarded packets ONLY where that protocol permits it and the response is eligible for TX; otherwise record the forwarding drop locally rather than inventing a MAC ACK/NACK or unsolicited mesh error. Runtime BEHAVIOR conforms everywhere (local recording + no invented MAC ACK/NACK): Python buf.stats.packets_backpressure asserted (python/tests/routing/test_no_silent_drops_vectors.py:47), Rust ForwardBuffer reject + ForwardStats (rust/lichen-node/src/forward_buffer.rs:121, test :319), C router.c:1504 reject. But documentation and vectors express the divergent intent: (1) rust/lichen-node/src/forward_buffer.rs:5-6,29-30,106-107 and rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:95,737 say 'a NACK should/SHOULD be sent upstream' — no such emission exists; (2) test/vectors/no_silent_drops.json requirement B.2.5.2 'NACK to mesh source (if routable)' mapped to ICMPv6 Destination Unreachable ADMIN_PROHIBITED via make_resource_exhausted — helper exists and is component-tested (python/src/lichen/ipv6/icmpv6.py:407, tests/routing/test_no_silent_drops_vectors.py imports it) but is NEVER called in any runtime src; C has LICHEN_ICMPV6_ADMIN_PROHIBITED (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/icmpv6.h:85) with no resource-exhausted builder; Rust has none; (3) test/vectors/bufferbloat_congestion.json fairness vector pins expected:'nack_when_source_full'. Also stale section refs: no_silent_drops.json spec_section 'B.2.5' and C tx_queue.h:70 'appendix-bufferbloat.md B.2.2' cite numbering the current spec does not use. Suggested placement: adjudicate whether ICMPv6 Dest-Unreachable(ADMIN_PROHIBITED) is the permitted existing-protocol response (flagged file question 6); then either wire the ICMPv6 emission in all three forwarding paths (python router.py BACKPRESSURE site :215, rust stack.rs queue() caller, C router.c) or fix the doc comments and regenerate no_silent_drops.json/bufferbloat_congestion.json. Report-conflicting-fixture rule applies: do not weaken tests without resolving the intent.
